newsitem.title: FINLAND: M-SERLA TO FOCUS ON PACKAGING, PRINTING.
newsitem.headline: M-SERLA TO FOCUS ON PACKAGING, PRINTING.

text.p: Finnish forest industry group Metsa-Serla Oy said in a statement on Thursday it would take action to improve its competitiveness by focussing on selected strategic core businesses.
"The strategic core businesses selected are packaging and printing. Competitive pulp production is also a key business area," the company said in its January-August interim report.
"Competitive businesses will continue to be part of the group structure; these businesses will finance the development of their operations with their own income," Metsa-Serla said.

The previous production-oriented approach will be replaced by a business approach "based on service and a local market presence", Metsa-Serla said, adding it would introduce a new group structure reflecting this thinking.
"In future, all Metsa-Serla's business operations will be examined from the viewpoint of those factors that most affect competitiveness," it said.
In addition to packaging, printing and pulp, Metsa-Serla produces paperboard, tissue and sawn goods.

Metsa-Serla earlier reported a sharply lower January-August profit after financial items at 254 million markka after financial items, down from 1.29 billion markka in the same period in 1995, and warned of a loss in the third tertial.
It saw improving earnings prospects in 1997.
